analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 29,195) below SMA5 (KRW 30,042) and SMA20 (KRW 35,973): confirming short- to mid-term bearish trend position.
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 39,909) and SMA200 (KRW 36,000): confirming strong mid- to long-term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (31.2%) + current price level is high relative to 52-week low (KRW 16,760), low relative to 52-week high (KRW 56,645).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.7→31.1): entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-466.3145→-1119.8628): bearish expansion, strengthening downtrend signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 28,322): approaching lower band, band width at 42.54% is relatively wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 29,075): pivot-based support near 5-day/20-day low (KRW 28,080).
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): first resistance zone on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low 28080, 20-day low 28080): no Higher Low confirmed, sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.40x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold, ADX trend weak, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
